item.text: {"criteria":[{"id":"PROGRESS_OUTPUT_NOT_OUTCOME","observation":"The response explicitly classifies 300 hours as “Effort, not progress” and the 60-page portal as “Output, not progress,” then states that no material progress toward reducing time-to-independent-work is evidenced.","status":"pass","turn_reviews":[{"observation":"T1 records the substantial effort and shipped output while refusing to infer goal progress from portal completion; it notes no starter usage, no remeasurement, and an unchanged approval bottleneck.","status":"pass","turn_id":"T1"}]},{"id":"PROGRESS_ENABLER_BOUNDED","observation":"The response keeps the approval bottleneck visible and makes future portal value conditional on testing and outcome evidence, but it says only that the portal “may eventually help” without limiting possible causal credit specifically to the named training-information constraint.","status":"fail","turn_reviews":[{"observation":"T1 appropriately requires actual starter use and measured time-to-independence and identifies the unchanged approval bottleneck, but it does not explicitly bound any potential portal-enabler credit to resolving a training-information constraint.","status":"fail","turn_id":"T1"}]}]}
